bbox_note: bbox_pct values are approximate (estimated by eye) and are only meant for matching regions; x, y = top-left, w, h = size, in percent of the page.
excluded: Printed page number '3' (bottom centre). Four small stacked 'Z' sleep marks above the walking ducklings in panels 3 and 4 (each a vertical stack of 4 shrinking Z's, letters about 8-12 px at native size; the number of Z's is not reliably countable) are excluded as tiny background lettering. The larger 'Z Z Z' stack in panel 1 is included.
page_notes: Funny-animal. SOUND-EFFECT-HEAVY case: 10 sound effects in several lettering styles (outlined, black brush, italic, slanted, one in a white motion trail). Also two park signs with stacked words. Speech balloons are rounded cartoon upper case.

regions.text: THAT'S RIGHT--YOU SHOULD NEVER AWAKEN A SLEEP-WALKER! BUT I'LL HAVE TO FOLLOW THEM!
regions.notes: 'SLEEP-' / 'WALKER!' across a line break. Kept with the hyphen (SLEEP-WALKER) because the 1940s spelling is hyphenated; a reader might write SLEEPWALKER. The double dash is drawn '-->'-like; written as '--'.
Three Z's stacked vertically next to the sleeping duck.

regions.text: YEOW! THEY'RE HEADED FOR THE STREET!

regions.notes: Outlined letters, slanted upward, on light blue sky.
Heavy black brush letters, slanted upward.
Small outlined letters inside a white speed band.
Italic letters in a white band, slanted.
Italic letters in a white band, slanted downward. Spelled SCREETCH as lettered.

regions.text: SHH! QUIET! WE MUSTN'T WAKE THEM!
regions.notes: Whisper balloon with a dotted outline. Drawn 'SHH!QUIET!' without a space.
Black letters on the pale yellow building wall, between two speed lines.
Bold black letters on pale yellow.
Italic black letters on pale pink, with a speed line.

regions.text: HE CAN'T FOLLOW US IN HERE!
CITY PARK NO DOGS ALLOWED DUCKS WELCOME
regions.notes: Hand-lettered sign on a park gatepost; one or two words per line; NO and ALLOWED underlined.

regions.text: SEE THE WILD ANIMALS TIGERS, BEAR ELEPHANTS ETC. NO DOGS ALLOWED
regions.notes: Second sign, partly hidden at its right edge by the next panel border: the word after TIGERS, shows as BEA plus a cut letter (most likely BEARS; only BEAR is written because the last letter is not visible), and the final S of ELEPHANTS and DOGS is partly cut but readable. ETC is followed by a small dot.
Black italic letters in a white motion trail, tilted downward; a small tick follows the H (not an exclamation mark).
